---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behavior or a crash
labels: bug
---

## What happened

A clear description of the bug, and what you expected instead.

## How to reproduce

The smallest formula, trace, or command that shows it. A copyable snippet is best.

## Environment

- SENTIL version and how you installed it (crate, wheel, jar, release archive, from source)
- Which surface (Rust, Python, C, C++, Java, Julia, MATLAB, CLI, ROS, embedded)
- Operating system and architecture

## Anything else

The exact error message, logs, or a stack trace if there is one.
